fluff.overview: The Flatbed Truck is among the most common wheeled vehicles found across the Inner Sphere, serving as the backbone of small-scale surface cargo transport on inhabited worlds throughout known space. Used extensively by both civilian enterprises and military logistical organizations, the flatbed's simple and rugged construction keeps maintenance requirements within reach of any competent mechanic. Its spacious armored cab and separate cargo trailer allow it to handle a wide range of payloads, from sensitive equipment to bulk materiel, making it a versatile asset in both commercial and military contexts. The flatbed's abundance and low cost have also made it an attractive platform for field modification, with armed variants appearing wherever forces find themselves short of proper combat vehicles.
fluff.capabilities: The Flatbed Truck is built around a Generic 30 ICE power plant, giving the ten-ton vehicle a top cruising speed of 54 kilometers per hour and a flank speed of 86 kilometers per hour when unloaded. The armored cab carries the driver and up to six tons of secured cargo, while the separate trailer bed accommodates up to ten additional tons of unprotected cargo. Loading the trailer to its rated maximum significantly reduces vehicle speed, as the small power plant operates near its practical limit under full load. Lightweight steel body panels offer modest protection for the cab and mechanical components. No standard communications or targeting systems are fitted from the factory, though military operators routinely add locally sourced equipment.
fluff.deployment: The autocannon-armed variant of the Flatbed Truck reduces standard cargo capacity to accommodate a direct-fire weapon system, providing a credible anti-vehicle capability from an improvised platform. These vehicles are most commonly encountered in irregular and militia forces operating in contested regions where purpose-built combat vehicles are unavailable, serving as a fire support asset within otherwise lightly armed convoys.
fluff.history:
The Flatbed Truck's origins predate the BattleMech era, drawing a direct lineage from terrestrial cargo vehicles that have moved goods across planetary surfaces for millennia. By the time of the Star League, standardized flatbed designs had been in continuous production across hundreds of worlds, assembled from widely available components by facilities ranging from major manufacturing complexes to local workshops. The Succession Wars brought significant disruption to many supply chains, but the flatbed's simple design and generic components allowed production to continue with minimal dependence on specialized factories throughout the technological decline of the late twenty-ninth and early thirtieth centuries.

Military forces that lost access to dedicated combat support vehicles increasingly turned to armed flatbed variants to fill gaps in their vehicle pools. This practice became common enough by the mid-Succession Wars that several configurations achieved widespread documentation and informal standardization. Armed flatbeds proved particularly prevalent in the Chaos March following the dissolution of the Federated Commonwealth, where resource-constrained planetary militias and mercenary commands improvised combat capability from whatever commercial vehicles were at hand. The type continues to be produced across every faction well into the post-Jihad era.
